method: Source-qualified AST inventory including private/nested definitions, existing-attribution and direct-literal screening, followed by primary-paper equation/table matching. Generic numerical controls and fixed regressions are not treated as empirical calibration. Inventory counts alone do not prove scientific correctness.
limits: Prompt-cusp a_kd=5.3e-12 is retained from the author implementation. The cited papers establish the thermal benchmark, but the exact numerical provenance of this scale factor was not independently recovered. Its source remains unresolved, explicitly in the class and constructor docstrings.

Correa concentration/history and Ludlow variance fits retain their original calibrations while the adopted background uses rounded Planck-2018 parameters. Misleading descriptions of a new Planck-2018 calibration were removed.

The concentration scatter 0.128 dex is the z=0, 1e9-1e10 Msun value in Ishiyama et al.; using it across mass/redshift is an assumption. C defaults to ct_th=0, so the literature threshold 0.77 is not falsely described as its active default.
The historical prompt-cusp calculation assumes a nonempty collapsed sample. This documentation audit does not repair its empty-sample path.

planck: Planck Collaboration (2020), Planck 2018 results. VI. Cosmological parameters, Table 2.
